oml:aggregation_method.description: Compare how GCOV backscatter was aggregated into SME2 grids.

oml:conventions.description: Conventions declared by the source product, not a claim of STAC Item CF compliance.

oml:diagnostic_mode.description: NASA Rev C Table 4.2.1 diagnosticModeFlag: 0 = science (DBFed), 1 or 2 = diagnostic mode; preserve integer code, not a derived boolean.

oml:dsg_algorithm_reference.description: Trace the disaggregation retrieval algorithm implementation/reference.

oml:frame_coverage_percentage.description: Filter by the actual producer-declared portion of a frame containing processed data.

oml:frame_number.description: Select consistent mission-defined ground frames across granules

oml:frequency_layers.description: Identify precisely which producer frequency layers are present.

oml:full_frame_threshold_percentage.description: Explain the threshold underlying the producer full-frame designation.

oml:input_gcov_granules.description: Trace directly named upstream L2 GCOV granules for provenance/cross-product lookup.

oml:is_full_frame.description: Distinguish full frame versus partial frame coverage

oml:is_geocoded.description: Identify source-declared radar versus map geometry.

oml:is_mixed_mode.description: Identify observations assembled from different radar modes.

oml:is_urgent_observation.description: Distinguish acquisition urgency from processing priority.

oml:pmi_algorithm_reference.description: Trace the polarimetric retrieval algorithm implementation/reference.

oml:polarization_layers.description: Original frequency-qualified polarization labels as declared by the SME2 producer, emitted only when a single STAC SAR polarization set is not semantically valid.

oml:present_algorithm_groups.description: DSG, PMI or TSR HDF5 groups actually present; presence is not evidence of successful algorithm execution.

oml:processing_type.description: NASA Rev C Table 4.2.1 processingType: producer-declared Nominal, Urgent, Custom or Undefined; do not confuse with observation urgency or STAC processing level.

oml:product_specification_version.description: Identify producer schema/specification compatibility independently of data versions.

oml:radar_frequency_parameters.description: Expose separate A/B frequency parameters when a single STAC SAR scalar cannot faithfully represent both.

oml:reference_document.description: Literal source product specification reference text, not a verified link or citation.

oml:source_geocoding.description: Producer-reported upstream GCOV geocoding metadata, preserving the source value; not evidence of the SME2 grid CRS.

oml:source_processing_datetime.description: Distinguish L2 source processing time from SME2 processing time.

oml:source_product_version.description: Compare source data versions across SME2 granules.

oml:source_rtc_algorithm_reference.description: Trace upstream terrain correction algorithm references.

oml:source_software_version.description: Distinguish source-processor software from SME2 processor version.

oml:spatial_filter.description: Compare spatial filtering methods for downstream processing choices.

oml:track_number.description: Group and compare repeat track acquisitions without assuming sat:relative_orbit semantics

oml:tsr_algorithm_reference.description: Trace the time-series retrieval algorithm implementation/reference.
